t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are pairs of gnomes and they don't change until the round is over. The advice was to focus on the colours versus the gnomes as it is fast. Better to try things on 1x than 5x.

vb_textbox.text: There are several pairs of gnomes that appear in each round. Each gnome in a pair rewards a different amount of points based on the mushrooms they have, so try to keep track of the pair combinations. You can see how many mushrooms they have visually. For example if the round is X5 and the gnome you pick has 6 mushrooms, giving 30 points, you can remember it started with 6 mushrooms. The mushroom amounts seem to change after each round completes.
